Issue title: AttributeError from contract errback

    results.addError(case, exc_info)

AttributeError: 'getset_descriptor' object has no attribute '__traceback__'

```
(HttpError('Ignoring non-200 response',), <class 'scrapy.spidermiddlewares.httperror.HttpError'>, <traceback object at 0x7f4bdca1d948>)
```

The supplied test command has already been run on the initial workspace. Its output follows.
Investigate both environment and source causes. Test execution stages are observations, not root-cause labels. Missing records mean unknown. Use the raw output when interpreting observations.
